description: This file contains functions for calculating energy coefficients for unfiltered and filtered excitation signals, as well as target energy, used in AMR speech codec processing. It includes functions like calc_unfilt_energies, calc_filt_energies, and calc_target_energy.

methods.name: calc_unfilt_energies
methods.description: Calculates energy coefficients for unfiltered excitation signals and the LTP coding gain based on residual, excitation, and code signals.

methods.name: calc_filt_energies
methods.description: Calculates energy coefficients for filtered excitation signals and the optimum codebook gain.

methods.name: calc_target_energy
methods.description: Calculates the target energy from the LTP target vector.
